name: BACH_0174_FSIM_resample3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated surgical frozen section [F1] has positive margins, severity-3 resample degradation, and disabled cell segmentation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | High invasive risk (ECE 5%) |
| Conformal set | Invasive (alpha 10%) | Single class; 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD percentile (12 tiles) [F6] | High reliability; atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (80%), 1/5 InSitu [F5] | Majority match; BACH_0160 is InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.18, +0.66) favors invasive; unreliable 0/20 spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Below-typical score (+0.38); differs from InSitu case BACH_0160 [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low benign stroma (+0.30) pushes toward invasive (20/20 spot-checked) [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Low duct confinement (+0.27) favors invasive over InSitu (12/20) · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.25), but unreliable weak concept (0/20 spot-checked) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops P(invasive) more than random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (95% CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 resample degradation on this simulated frozen section masks ducts or mimics invasion (reliability error AUROC 70%).
- Lesion is InSitu like similar case BACH_0160 (79% similarity), since validated invasion score slightly opposes invasion (-0.19).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0–3, 8–11**: Verify tumor at superior and inferior margins (108 um strips) on frozen section [F7].
2. **Region 0**: Confirm stromal invasion and nuclear pleomorphism (validated concepts) versus resample artifact; stains are blocked.
3. **Regions 6, 9**: Check duct confinement and TILs to exclude InSitu contrast case BACH_0160.
